sourceCode.description: Where the source code of the running version is

averagePlacing.description: Of the Plays recorded with scores. 1 is first.

expires.description: When it stops working. Absent when it never does.

lastUsed.description: When it was last used, recorded at most once an hour. Absent when it never was.

playerIds.description: The Players that an Account has claimed

secret.description: The API Key itself, starting with bk_. Send it as "Authorization: Bearer …".

Expansion.description: In a Play's Setup, "true" when it was played with, and "false" or absent when not

FieldProblem.description: For the code request.invalid: the fields that broke a rule

code.description: The rule that was broken, such as size or notblank

cooperative.description: For a Game scored by the Generic Module: how its Plays are recorded by default

hasOwnModule.description: Whether the Game has a Game Module of its own. Such a Game cannot be edited or removed.

moduleKey.description: The key of the Game Module that scores the Game, such as "calico". Absent when that module is not installed.

name.description: The name as stored. A Game with a module of its own is shown under the name in the module's texts instead: "<moduleKey>.name".

changed.description: How many of them got different Results

plays.description: How many Plays the Game has

refused.description: The Plays the Game Module refuses now, which kept their Results

GameReference.description: The Game of a Play, with the name to show for it

moduleKey.description: For a Game with a Game Module of its own: the module's key. The Game is then shown under the name in the module's texts, "<moduleKey>.name".

cooperative.description: Everyone wins or loses together, against the game

lowestScoreWins.description: For a competitive Play recorded in points: the lowest score wins

categoryAverages.description: In the Plays in which Players played against each other: the average of each Score Category, by the category's key. Only Plays scored by the Game Module of today count. Averages are not rounded.

cooperative.description: How the group did in the Cooperative Plays. Absent when there are none.

gameModuleId.description: The Game Module that scores the Game today. The keys in "categoryAverages" are its Score Categories.

lastPlayedOn.description: The day of the latest Play. Absent when there is none.

players.description: One for each Player who played the Game against others, the most wins first

plays.description: How many times the Game was played, Cooperative and Solo Plays included

solo.description: One for each Player who played the Game on their own, the most Plays first

victoryTypes.description: For a Game that can be won in more than one way: how many Plays were won in each way, the most first. Only Plays scored by the Game Module of today count. Empty for other Games.

scores.description: The group's value for each Score Category. The Generic Module has one, "total".
As entered: the group's value for each Score Category

total.description: Absent when no score was recorded

GroupStats.description: How the group did in the Cooperative Plays

bestScore.description: The highest score of the group. Absent when no score was recorded.

roleId.description: The Role the new Account starts with. Member if left out.

playedOn.description: The day of the Game's latest Play

NamedReference.description: A Player, with the name to show for them

name.description: A name to recognise it by, unique among your API Keys, such as "Backup script"

passkey.description: What credential.toJSON() returns for the options from POST /api/account/api-keys/passkey-options. Send either this or your password.

password.description: Your password. Send either this or a passkey.

token.description: The secret part of the link: the person registers at /register/{token}

label.description: A name to recognise it by, such as "My phone"

group.description: For a Cooperative Play: how it ended for the group

id.description: Only when recording, and optional: the new Play's id, chosen by the device. A Play is recorded once per id: sending it again gives back the Play already recorded. Another Account's Play with the same id is refused with plays.idTaken. Use a UUID of version 7, which starts with the time: the history orders a day's Plays by id.

location.description: Where it was played, in your own words

playedOn.description: The day it was played. Not later than today.

players.description: Who played, in the order you want them listed

setup.description: The Setup: the value chosen for each Variant, and whether each Expansion was played with, by their keys. The keys are the Game Module's. An on/off Variant and an Expansion are "true" or "false". The Generic Module has the on/off Variants "cooperative" and "lowestScoreWins".

victoryType.description: How the Play was won: the key of one of the Game Module's Victory Types. Only for a Game that can be won in more than one way, and not for a Solo Play. A Victory Type not on points is recorded with WINNER_ONLY and one winner.

token.description: The secret part of the link: the person opens /reset-password/{token}

OnlyWhen.description: A condition on a Play's Setup

key.description: The key of a Variant or an Expansion

value.description: The value it has to have. For an Expansion, "true" when it is played with.

lastUsed.description: When it was last used to sign in. Absent when it never was.

staySignedIn.description: Stay signed in on this device for 90 days after the last visit

canChange.description: Whether the signed-in Account may edit and delete this Play

cooperative.description: Whether the Players won or lost together

gameModuleId.description: The Game Module that scored this Play. The keys in "setup" and "scores" are its. It can differ from the module that scores the Game today.

group.description: For a Cooperative Play: how it ended for the group

recordedBy.description: The Player of the Account that recorded it

results.description: One per Player, in the order they were entered

victoryType.description: How the Play was won: the key of one of its Game Module's Victory Types. Absent for a Game that is won in one way only.

next.description: Pass this as "after" to get the next page. Absent when this is the last page.

results.description: One per Player, in the order they were entered

tieForRecorder.description: The Players of a tie for first place that the recorder may decide. Empty when the scores decide who won.

PlayPreviewRequest.description: What is entered about how a Play went, with the Game Module to score it

scores.description: The value for each Score Category, by the category's key. The Generic Module has one, "total". Leave it out when only the winner is recorded.

setup.description: The Player Setup, such as their Wonder: the option chosen for each of the Game Module's Player Setup choices, by the choice's key. Leave out a choice nobody made.

winner.description: Whether you mark this Player as a winner. With Recording Mode WINNER_ONLY that is the Result. With POINTS it decides a tie for first place.

PlayerGameStats.description: How a Player did in one Game, in the Plays with others. Cooperative Plays count in plays and wins; the scores and Placings come from the Plays against others only.

bestScore.description: The best total: the highest, or the lowest when the lowest score wins. Absent when no score was recorded.

PlayerSetupChoice.description: Something chosen for each Player, such as their Wonder. It may be left out for a Player.

oncePerPlay.description: Whether no two Players of a Play can have the same option

options.description: The keys of the options, in the order to offer them

PlayerSoloStats.description: How a Player did in the Solo Plays of one Game

playsAgainstOpponent.description: The Solo Plays against an automated opponent, which are won or lost

wins.description: The Solo Plays won against the Game's automated opponent

PlayerStats.description: How a Player did in the Plays in which they played against others

averagePlacing.description: The average Placing, of the Plays recorded with scores. 1 is first.

averageScore.description: The average total, of the Plays recorded with scores

bestScore.description: The best total: the highest, or the lowest when the lowest score wins. Absent when no score was recorded.

wins.description: The Plays the Player won, shared wins included

PlayerSummary.description: How a Player did in all the Games they played

againstOthers.description: The Plays against others. Absent when there are none.

games.description: One for each Game the Player played with others, the most played first

lastPlayedOn.description: The day of the latest Play. Absent when there is none.

plays.description: Every Play the Player took part in

solo.description: One for each Game the Player played on their own, the most played first

together.description: The Cooperative Plays. Absent when there are none.

won.description: Absent in a Solo Play recorded for score only

code.description: What went wrong, as a code for the frontend to translate, such as players.nameTaken

errors.description: For the code request.invalid: the fields that broke a rule

reason.description: For the code plays.invalidEntry: why the Game Module refused the Play, as a name in that module's texts, such as generic.invalid.winnerMissing

changed.description: Whether the Results came out different from those stored

play.description: The Play as it is now

reason.description: Why, as the name of a text: under "problems" in the frontend's texts, or a Game Module's own such as "<module>.invalid.<reason>"

playerName.description: The Player the new Account will claim

Result.description: What one Player got in a Play

markedWinner.description: As entered: whether the recorder marked the Player as a winner

placing.description: Absent in a Cooperative Play and a Solo Play, and when only the winner was recorded

scores.description: As entered: the value for each Score Category

setup.description: As entered: the Player Setup, the option chosen for each of the Game Module's Player Setup choices

total.description: Absent when no scores were recorded for the Player

won.description: Absent in a Solo Play recorded for score only, which nobody wins or loses

builtIn.description: ADMIN or MEMBER for the two built-in Roles; absent for any other

max.description: The highest value allowed. Absent when there is none.

min.description: The lowest value allowed. Absent when there is none.

onlyWhen.description: The row is on the pad only when the Setup has this value. Absent for a row that is always on it.

soloOnly.description: Whether the row is on the pad of a Solo Play only

step.description: Every value is a multiple of this

ScorePad.description: What is entered for a Play of the module's Game. It holds keys; what people read is in the module's texts: "<module>.expansion.<key>", "<module>.variant.<key>", "<module>.category.<key>", "<module>.victoryType.<key>", "<module>.playerSetup.<key>", "<module>.playerSetup.<key>.<option>" and "<module>.tie".

categories.description: The rows of the score pad, in its order

cooperative.description: Whether the Players win or lose together. The categories are then the group's, entered once for the Play, and the module works out the group's score from them.

expansions.description: The Expansions a Play can be played with, in the order to offer them

maxPlayers.description: Absent when there is no limit

playerSetup.description: The choices made for each Player, such as their Wonder, in the order to offer them. Empty for a Game without Player Setup.

recorderDecidesTies.description: Whether the recorder is asked who won a tie for first place that the scores cannot decide

solo.description: How a Solo Play is recorded. Absent for a Game that is not played alone.

usualRecordingMode.description: The Recording Mode a new Play starts with

victoryTypes.description: The ways a Play can be won, the usual one first. Empty for a Game that is won in one way only.

account.description: The signed-in Account. Absent when nobody is signed in.

playerName.description: The name of the Player that the new Account claims

staySignedIn.description: Stay signed in on this device for 90 days after the last visit

opponentCategory.description: For AGAINST_OPPONENT: the key of the Score Category with the opponent's score

tieWins.description: For AGAINST_OPPONENT: whether the Player wins when level with the opponent

SoloStats.description: How a Player did in the Solo Plays

bestScore.description: The best total: the highest, or the lowest when the lowest score wins. Absent when no score was recorded.

playsAgainstOpponent.description: The Solo Plays against an automated opponent, which are won or lost. The others were played for a score only.

wins.description: The Solo Plays won against the Game's automated opponent

Together.description: Cooperative Plays, which the whole group wins or loses

defaultValue.description: What a Setup holds when nothing was chosen. For ON_OFF, "true" or "false"; for RANGE, a number as text.

max.description: For a RANGE: the highest number

min.description: For a RANGE: the lowest number

onlyWhen.description: It is chosen only when the Setup has this value, such as an adversary's level once that adversary is chosen. Absent when it always is.

options.description: For a CHOICE: the keys of the options, in the order to offer them

soloOnly.description: Whether it is chosen for a Solo Play only

onPoints.description: Whether the score pad decides the winner. If not, the Play ended outright: it is recorded with WINNER_ONLY and has one winner.

onlyWhen.description: This way of winning is possible only when the Setup has this value. Absent when it always is.

key.description: The key of one of the Game Module's Victory Types
